probes.text: The summer interns are packing up to leave, and the whole office is gossiping while Michael feels left out.
Pam is chasing down wedding RSVPs and struggling to get responses back from guests.
Pam feels awkward as she asks her coworkers for cash instead of wedding gifts.
Chaos spreads through the office as everyone argues about tiny or nonexistent annual raises.
Kevin is treating Jim's empty office as his own private farting room while Jim is away.
Michael, Dwight and Andy sit together at lunch with the insurance salesman.
Michael slips and falls fully clothed into a koi pond while walking to a business meeting.
Clients keep mistaking Pam and Andy for a couple during their sales calls together.
Michael calls the office together for an anti-bullying seminar after everyone teases him relentlessly.
Michael makes the whole office spend the day playing a murder mystery role-playing game.
The entire office staff puts work aside to spend the day on group diversions together.
Michael, Dwight and Oscar sit together in a hired limousine leaving New York.
Erin keeps offering Michael support even as he treats her rudely all day.
Phyllis is dressed as Santa for the office Christmas party while Michael shows up as Santa too.
Michael sits through the office Christmas party dressed in a full Jesus costume.
Andy gives Erin a Twelve Days of Christmas gift and the birds start attacking her.
Michael, Dwight, Andy and Pam trot out their high-profile contacts to impress a visiting investment banker.
Toby sits with coworkers reminiscing about all the great times they have had in the office.
Jim and Pam sit together at a local daycare center for an interview about childcare.
Michael turns to David for advice about handling the company's new policies.
Andy hands Kelly the Valentine's card he actually meant to give to Erin.
Jim follows clues on a treasure hunt that winds all through the business park.
The sales team acts superior around the office under Sabre's sales-is-king mantra.
Oscar invites the office and warehouse crews out together for after-work drinks at a bar.
Oscar spends the evening at the bar flirting with Matt from the warehouse crew.
Pam arrives at after-work drinks with a date she has set up for Michael.
Oscar circulates a homemade video comparing Kevin's voice to a growly blue children's-show monster.
Kevin looks for help when the entire office gets in on the joke about his voice.
Andy arranges extra special touches for the day honoring Erin as office secretary.
Dwight sits with Kelly and earnestly encourages her to try out for the minority training program.
Jim and Pam sit together preparing their first joint sales pitch to Donna, a local restaurant manager.
Andy wanders the office with a customer complaint, frustrated that no one takes it seriously.
Dwight acts as Michael's earnest private investigator, quietly working a case for him.
Exhausted new parents Jim and Pam fight to keep their eyes open through the workday in the office.
Michael sleeps on the hotel hallway floor next to the humming ice machine.
The whole office has Friday and Monday off to attend the Niagara Falls wedding.
Dwight does renovation work in Jim and Pam's kitchen and runs into Isabel there at their house.
